project_type: Python robotics reliability platform with MuJoCo simulation, PyTorch ML, pytest tests
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, pip install -e '.[ml]' for PyTorch extras
test_framework: pytest with markers: @unit (no ROS), @integration (ROS). Currently 149 tests, all passing.
build_command: pip install -e '.[ml]' (no separate build step — pure Python)
verification_instructions: Run python3 -m pytest tests/ -v from /root/forge. All 149 existing tests must continue to pass. New tests for experiment tracking and model registry must also pass.
environment_constraints: WSL Ubuntu environment. Use 'wsl -d Ubuntu -e bash -c "cd /root/forge && <cmd>"' to run commands. PyTorch is available (installed under [ml] extra). No ROS required for testing.
contribution_requirements: forge_core/ modules have ZERO ROS dependency. All configuration is YAML-driven. JSON/YAML for persistent data. Human-readable files. No external ML tracking deps (no MLflow/W&B). Run data lives in runs/run_XXXXX/. Match existing code style: dataclasses, logging with logger = logging.getLogger(__name__), type hints, docstrings.
key_patterns: Modules use PROJECT_ROOT from forge_core.config for all path resolution
Classes use @dataclass for data containers (TrainResult, RunRecord, EvalResult)
Registries are dicts mapping names to classes (POLICY_REGISTRY, FAULT_REGISTRY)
CLI scripts add project root to sys.path, use argparse, call setup_logging()
Config files live in config/, use load_yaml() from forge_core.config
Saved artifacts use sequential IDs: run_XXXXX, and JSON for metadata
Tests use pytest fixtures, tmp_path for file I/O, monkeypatch for isolation
train_bc() returns a TrainResult dataclass with training history
Policy loading via create_policy(name, **kwargs) with lazy imports
relevant_files: /root/forge/forge_core/learned_policy.py — train_bc(), TrainResult, collect_demos(), DemoDataset, PolicyNetwork, LearnedPolicy
/root/forge/forge_core/recorder.py — get_next_run_id() pattern for sequential IDs, save_run()
/root/forge/tests/unit/test_learned_policy.py — test patterns: synthetic_run_dir fixture, DemoDataset tests, config merge tests
/root/forge/README.md — status, structure, features, test count, roadmap
directory_structure: forge/ (project root) -> forge_core/ (core library, no ROS), scripts/ (CLI tools), config/ (YAML configs), tests/unit/ + tests/integration/, tasks/ (task YAMLs), faults/ (fault YAMLs), runs/ (recorded runs), models/ (saved .pt files), docs/ (architecture.md, setup.md), simulation/ (MuJoCo models/worlds/scenarios)
